entries.title: A small dot by a panel's name says when it needs a look
entries.body: A paused or stopped panel, or one waiting for your OK, now shows a small dot beside its name instead of a line above its content. Rest on the dot, or reach it with Tab, to see one line; press it to read the details and act. The dot also appears when a panel's background reads keep failing, and Ask the first mate has it look into why. Your own panels no longer carry the word yours. The phone shows the same dot.

picture.alt: A Growth panel with an orange dot by its name, and its details open: background reads are failing, with the connector's answer and an Ask the first mate button
